title: Obituaries
author: Ben Thompson
description: The demise of Jensen Huang was the end of a great many things, including Nvidia's long-term prospects, the AI bubble, and the exceptional way in which the U.S. viewed itself in the world.
summary: Listen to this post: Dearly beloved, we are gathered here today to get through this thing called life. ― Prince Jensen Huang, CEO of Nvidia, 1993–2026 Jensen Huang resigned as CEO of Nvidia on Thursday, November 12, 2026. He had been CEO of the company ever since he founded it on April 5, 1993.
takeaways: ChatGPT made clear what GPUs were most useful for: large language models, and Nvidia made the best GPUs.

Start with CUDA: when the market was software written for GPUs, a platform — including not just an API but a huge set of libraries targeting every conceivable market for accelerated computing — was a nearly impenetrable moat.
The first is that the vast majority of developer energy moved up the stack, using the LLM’s API as a platform; for most companies, CUDA didn’t matter.
